article.title: Philadelphia plays conference rival Milwaukee
article.story: Milwaukee Bucks (0-2, 15th in the Eastern Conference) vs. Philadelphia 76ers (2-0, third in the Eastern Conference) Philadelphia; Saturday, 7:30 p.m. EDT LINE: 76ers -12.5; over/under is 232.5 BOTTOM LINE: Milwaukee plays Philadelphia in Eastern Conference action Saturday. Philadelphia finished 45-37 overall, 27-25 in Eastern Conference play and 23-18 at home during the 2025-26 season. The 76ers averaged 18.9 points off of turnovers, 15.4 second-chance points and 32.4 bench points last season. Milwaukee went 32-50 overall and 21-31 in Eastern Conference action during the 2025-26 season. The Bucks averaged 110.6 points per game last season, 13.9 from the free-throw line and 45.3 from 3-point range. INJURIES: 76ers: Ariel Hukporti: out for season (achilles), Tacko Fall: out (hip), Dean Wade: out (ankle), Dominick Barlow: out (back), LeBron James: day to day (back). Bucks: None listed. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
